description.value: Small private campground on the west arm of Kootenay Lake in Balfour, with only 4 waterfront tent sites, a private beach, flush washrooms with showers, and mountain views in every direction; the RV-heavy layout means tent spots are scarce and should be confirmed by phone before making it a target.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website confirms this is an RV park and campground in Balfour, BC (27km from Nelson) on Kootenay Lake, with 4 waterfront tent sites, public washrooms/showers, fire pits, and picnic tables. Phone (250) 229-4275 and address 7048 Lee Rd are confirmed across multiple pages. OSM had no phone or address so those contact fields can't be cross-confirmed. Showers are explicitly mentioned multiple times ('public washrooms and showers'). Reservations are accepted via 'BOOK NOW' buttons and phone booking. No mention of hiker/biker-specific sites, laundry, cyclist discounts, or most other amenities.
concerns: Park is actually located in Balfour, BC (27km north of Nelson), not in Nelson proper despite the name and OSM community tag
Reviews indicate mostly seasonal/full-time sites with limited transient availability
Front page displays 'Lakeside RV Park & Marina' as a heading, which differs from the OSM name and the rest of the website's branding as 'Nelson RV Park & Marina'
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Active campground with tent sites on a key cycling corridor (Hwy 3A) between Nelson and the Balfour ferry; useful stop for touring cyclists despite being primarily an RV park.
enrichment_extras.notes: Email available: nelsonrvparkandmarina@gmail.com. Formerly known as Birch Grove RV Park & Marina.

wow_evidence: 4 waterfront tent sites, a private beach, flush washrooms with showers
